_doc: Trades pack (systems/tradeSkills.js): Smithing, Tanning & Weaving, Brewing and Medicine as practised skills. The three craft skills take over the old 0-10 craft skills of player/crafting.js through trades.craftSkills (old craft skill id -> practised skill): the recipe modal and the craft roll read the level from here, and old saves' player.skills values (and the old crafting rank) migrate into XP (a level v of the old scale becomes the XP where (level - 1) + progress = v). Craft perks: quality = craftsmanship added to the grade roll (in place of the old level x perLevel); waste = % of each input lost when the work spoils; minutes = time a piece takes; forge (smithing) = extra steadiness at the anvil (the forge minigame's zones widen as with that much more strength); spare = % chance of one more unit from a success. xp.craft: practised XP per point of a recipe's xp (a spoiled piece gives its failure share). Medicine perks: remedy = % more from remedies, salves and potions (health, dressing days, mending, the odds of drawing an infection or easing a stage); care = % less likely a sickness worsens or kills you (your own physicking, systems/ailments.js careFactor); resist = % less likely to catch one; mend = % faster your wounds mend; tend = % chance to nurse a sick companion through it yourself (once a day each, using herbs or a remedy). xp: heal (a healing item used), remedy (one used on a wound or sickness), tendWin / tendFail, treated (watching a physician at work). NPCs: roles and dailyXp as in practiceSkills.json (base -1: a person outside the trades tops out at 3 by spread and age, under the notable level; the trades' roles carry +2 to make up for it); craftTrades: a share of some roles work a craft on the side (picked by a hash of who they are) and take that trade's levels and daily XP too. trades.tradeSkills: which town trades (data/markets.json recipes, commissions) are worked with which skill; trades.hired: the best hand in town at the skill adds (level - ref) x perLevel to the craftsmanship of hired work (systems/commissions.js); trades.physician: a town's physician or herbalist is its best healer (townsfolk) or a typical one for its size, and treats at (level - typical) x perLevel better; trades.companions: a healer companion's care scales with their Medicine level against ref (never better than min).

waste.show: {v}% of the materials lost when work spoils
